outcome_note: 2/3 seeds ready; 2493 genuine fresh E3 selection events captured, 2348 disagreement events (94.2%); committed_fraction 0.000. Replay validity (reconstructed vs selector's own distribution, worst abs err): 7.87e-09. PRIMARY: C1 (literal-F lesion) mean delta_p_safer on disagreement events = -0.00000; C1 mean total variation 0.0005177; competitor influence at factual F 0.086, at F-lesioned 0.096. See hypothesis_evaluation for the H1-H4 pattern read (READ THE SELECTOR REGIME NOTE FIRST).

notes: NEAR-UNIFORM SELECTION: normalised selection entropy 0.99820 (1.0 = uniform over K candidates), mean score range 0.3282 against temperature 1. At this scale the softmax is essentially flat, so NO channel -- literal F included -- is meaningfully steering the choice. This is a materially different situation from 'F dominates and suppresses competitors': a variance decomposition can attribute ~96% of score VARIANCE to F (V3-EXQ-924) while F's ABSOLUTE contribution is far too small relative to T to move selection. Read every authority number below in that light, and treat 'F-dominance' claims resting on variance-share alone as unestablished on this configuration.

SELECTOR REGIME: committed_fraction=0.000 -- the selector predominantly SAMPLED from softmax(-scores/T) rather than taking the committed argmin. The distributional DVs (delta_p_safer, delta_rank_safer, delta_expected_hazard_dist) are therefore the load-bearing readouts; the argmin-flip columns describe what a DETERMINISTIC selector would have done on the same score vectors and must not be read as the behaviour of this run. This is itself a substantive observation about the substrate: MECH-439's 'committed-selection variance monopoly' framing presumes committed selection, and commitment was largely not engaged here.

C1 moved the distribution (total variation 0.0005177) but produced no consistent movement toward or away from the independently-preferred candidate (mean delta_p_safer -0.0000). F has causal authority but that authority is not aligned with -- nor opposed to -- the ground-truth safety axis; removing it reshuffles rather than improves.
MECH-448 eligibility toggling rarely changes the winner -- no strong evidence the eligibility mechanism itself (as opposed to literal F) is an independent locus of dominance in this sample.

methodology_note: Frozen-state causal-replay diagnostic. P0 trains SD-056 (E2 world-forward action-conditional divergence, verbatim V3-EXQ-643a recipe) so candidates genuinely differentiate in z_world space -- verified empirically this session that without it, gated_policy (ARC-062's rule-apprehension channel) reads std_across_K=0.0 even when enabled, an upstream-representation problem, not a selector-authority problem. P1 captures genuine fresh E3 selections only (latch-cleared, per V3-EXQ-924's fix) and replays C0-C5 counterfactuals INLINE on the captured per-candidate f/harm/gated_policy vectors -- pure arithmetic, no re-touching the live agent/env. Independent criterion: env-native ground-truth distance to the nearest known hazard after the candidate's first action (never a network output). Deferred: ofc/lateral_pfc/dacc/curiosity/tonic_vigor as competitors (see module docstring for why); MECH-449 Go/No-Go; a developmental contingency-switch follow-on (pending this run's findings, per the user's brief -- not built automatically).
